==================== backend\artisan ====================
#!/usr/bin/env php
<?php

use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\ArgvInput;

define('LARAVEL_START', microtime(true));

// Register the Composer autoloader...
require __DIR__.'/vendor/autoload.php';

// Bootstrap Laravel and handle the command...
/** @var Application $app */
$app = require_once __DIR__.'/bootstrap/app.php';

$status = $app->handleCommand(new ArgvInput);

exit($status);

## About Laravel

Laravel is a web application framework with expressive, elegant syntax. We believe development must be an enjoyable and creative experience to be truly fulfilling. Laravel takes the pain out of development by easing common tasks used in many web projects, such as:

- [Simple, fast routing engine](https://laravel.com/docs/routing).
- [Powerful dependency injection container](https://laravel.com/docs/container).
- Multiple back-ends for [session](https://laravel.com/docs/session) and [cache](https://laravel.com/docs/cache) storage.
- Expressive, intuitive [database ORM](https://laravel.com/docs/eloquent).
- Database agnostic [schema migrations](https://laravel.com/docs/migrations).
- [Robust background job processing](https://laravel.com/docs/queues).
- [Real-time event broadcasting](https://laravel.com/docs/broadcasting).

Laravel is accessible, powerful, and provides tools required for large, robust applications.

If you don't feel like reading, [Laracasts](https://laracasts.com) can help. Laracasts contains thousands of video tutorials on a range of topics including Laravel, modern PHP, unit testing, and JavaScript. Boost your skills by digging into our comprehensive video library.

==================== backend\app\Http\Controllers\Api\AuthController.php ====================
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function login(Request $request)
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'email' => 'required|email',
            'password' => 'required|string',
            'device_name' => 'required|string',
        ]);

        $user = User::where('email', $data['email'])->first();

        if (! $user || ! Hash::check($data['password'], $user->password)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => ['Those details do not match our records.'],
            ])->status(401);
        }

        $token = $user->createToken($data['device_name'])->plainTextToken;

        return response()->json([
            'token' => $token,
            'user' => [
                'name' => $user->name,
                'email' => $user->email,
                'role' => $user->role,
                'title' => $user->title,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function logout(Request $request)
    {
        $request->user()->currentAccessToken()->delete();
        return response()->json(['message' => 'Logged out']);
    }
}

==================== backend\app\Http\Controllers\Api\OrderController.php ====================
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\MenuItem;
use App\Models\Order;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class OrderController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        return Order::with('items')->latest()->paginate(30);
    }

    public function store(Request $r)
    {
        $data = $r->validate([
            'customer_name' => 'required|string|max:120',
            'customer_email' => 'required|email:rfc|max:255',
            'customer_phone' => 'nullable|string|max:30',
            'type' => 'required|in:pickup,delivery,preorder,takeaway',
            'scheduled_for' => 'nullable|required_if:type,preorder|date|after:now',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string|max:1000',
            'tip_amount' => 'integer|min:0',
            'tip_note' => 'nullable|string|max:120',
            'items' => 'required|array|min:1|max:30',
            'items.*.menu_item_id' => 'required|integer|distinct|exists:menu_items,id',
            'items.*.quantity' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:20',
        ]);

        $order = DB::transaction(function () use ($data) {
            $subtotal = 0;
            $lines = [];

            foreach ($data['items'] as $line) {
                $item = MenuItem::lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($line['menu_item_id']);

                if (! $item->is_available || $item->available_quantity < $line['quantity']) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'items' => ["{$item->name} is unavailable in that quantity."],
                    ]);
                }

                $cost = $item->price * $line['quantity'];
                $subtotal += $cost;
                $lines[] = [$item, $line['quantity'], $cost];
            }

            $service = round($subtotal * .075, 2);
            $tip = $data['tip_amount'] ?? 0;

            $order = Order::create([
                ...collect($data)->except('items')->all(),
                'reference' => 'NK-'.str()->upper(str()->random(8)),
                'subtotal' => $subtotal,
                'service_charge' => $service,
                'total' => $subtotal + $service + $tip,
            ]);

            foreach ($lines as [$item, $qty, $cost]) {
                $order->items()->create([
                    'menu_item_id' => $item->id,
                    'name' => $item->name,
                    'unit_price' => $item->price,
                    'quantity' => $qty,
                    'total' => $cost,
                ]);
                $item->decrement('available_quantity', $qty);
            }

            return $order->load('items');
        });

        return response()->json($order, 201);
    }

    public function updateStatus(Request $r, Order $order)
    {
        $order->update($r->validate([
            'status' => 'required|in:new,confirmed,preparing,ready,completed,cancelled',
        ]));

        return $order;
    }
}

==================== backend\app\Http\Controllers\Api\TipReportController.php ====================
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Order;

class TipReportController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        return Order::selectRaw('YEARWEEK(created_at) as week, SUM(tip_amount) as total_tips')
            ->groupBy('week')
            ->orderByDesc('week')
            ->get();
    }
}

==================== backend\app\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\OrderController.php ====================
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\MenuItem;
use App\Models\Order;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class OrderController extends Controller
{
    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'customer_name'  => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'customer_email' => ['required', 'email'],
            'customer_phone' => ['required', 'string', 'max:30'],
            'type'           => ['required', 'in:takeaway,pickup,delivery'],
            'tip_amount'     => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0'],
            'tip_note'       => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'items'          => ['required', 'array', 'min:1'],
            'items.*.menu_item_id' => ['required', 'exists:menu_items,id'],
            'items.*.quantity'     => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:50'],
        ]);

        $subtotal = 0;
        $orderItems = [];

        foreach ($data['items'] as $row) {
            $item = MenuItem::findOrFail($row['menu_item_id']);
            $line = (float) $item->price * (int) $row['quantity'];
            $subtotal += $line;
            $orderItems[] = [
                'menu_item_id' => $item->id,
                'name'         => $item->name,
                'quantity'     => $row['quantity'],
                'price'        => $item->price,
            ];
        }

        $service = round($subtotal * 0.075, 2);
        $tip     = (float) ($data['tip_amount'] ?? 0);
        $total   = round($subtotal + $service + $tip, 2);

        $order = Order::create([
            'reference'      => 'WSK-' . strtoupper(Str::random(8)),
            'customer_name'  => $data['customer_name'],
            'customer_email' => $data['customer_email'],
            'customer_phone' => $data['customer_phone'],
            'type'           => $data['type'],
            'subtotal'       => $subtotal,
            'service'        => $service,
            'tip_amount'     => $tip,
            'tip_note'       => $data['tip_note'] ?? null,
            'total'          => $total,
            'status'         => 'new',
        ]);

        foreach ($orderItems as $row) {
            $order->items()->create($row);
        }

        return response()->json($order->load('items'), 201);
    }

    public function adminIndex(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $query = Order::with('items')->orderBy('created_at', 'desc');

        if ($request->filled('status')) {
            $query->where('status', $request->status);
        }

        return response()->json(['data' => $query->limit(100)->get()]);
    }

    public function adminUpdate(Request $request, Order $order): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'status' => ['required', 'in:new,confirmed,preparing,ready,completed,cancelled'],
        ]);

        $order->update(['status' => $data['status']]);

        return response()->json($order->fresh()->load('items'));
    }
}


==================== backend\app\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\ReportController.php ====================
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Order;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;

class ReportController extends Controller
{
    public function tips(): JsonResponse
    {
        $rows = Order::query()
            ->selectRaw("DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%x-W%v') as week")
            ->selectRaw('SUM(tip_amount) as total_tips')
            ->where('tip_amount', '>', 0)
            ->groupBy('week')
            ->orderBy('week', 'desc')
            ->limit(12)
            ->get();

        return response()->json($rows);
    }
}


==================== backend\app\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\ReservationController.php ====================
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Reservation;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class ReservationController extends Controller
{
    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'name'        => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'email'       => ['required', 'email'],
            'phone'       => ['required', 'string', 'max:30'],
            'guest_count' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:50'],
            'reserved_at' => ['required', 'date'],
            'occasion'    => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
        ]);

        $reservation = Reservation::create([
            ...$data,
            'status' => 'new',
        ]);

        return response()->json($reservation, 201);
    }

    public function adminIndex(): JsonResponse
    {
        return response()->json([
            'data' => Reservation::orderBy('reserved_at', 'desc')->limit(100)->get(),
        ]);
    }

    public function adminUpdate(Request $request, Reservation $reservation): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'status' => ['required', 'in:new,confirmed,seated,completed,cancelled'],
        ]);

        $reservation->update(['status' => $data['status']]);

        return response()->json($reservation->fresh());
    }
}


==================== backend\app\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\StaffAuthController.php ====================
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Staff;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class StaffAuthController extends Controller
{
    public function login(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'email'    => ['required', 'email'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]);

        $staff = Staff::where('email', $data['email'])->first();

        if (! $staff || ! Hash::check($data['password'], $staff->password)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'email' => ['The provided credentials are incorrect.'],
            ]);
        }

        $staff->tokens()->delete();
        $token = $staff->createToken('staff_token')->plainTextToken;

        return response()->json([
            'token' => $token,
            'user'  => [
                'id'    => $staff->id,
                'name'  => $staff->name,
                'email' => $staff->email,
                'role'  => $staff->role,
                'title' => $staff->title,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function me(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        return response()->json(['user' => $request->user()]);
    }

    public function logout(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->user()->currentAccessToken()->delete();
        return response()->json(['message' => 'Logged out.']);
    }
}


==================== backend\app\Http\Middleware\EnsureUserHasRole.php ====================
<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class EnsureUserHasRole
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next, ...$roles)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if (! $user || ! in_array($user->role, $roles, true)) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Not authorised for this action.'], 403);
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

==================== backend\config\session.php ====================
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Default Session Driver
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option determines the default session driver that is utilized for
    | incoming requests. Laravel supports a variety of storage options to
    | persist session data. Database storage is a great default choice.
    |
    | Supported: "file", "cookie", "database", "memcached",
    |            "redis", "dynamodb", "array"
    |
    */

    'driver' => env('SESSION_DRIVER', 'database'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Lifetime
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may specify the number of minutes that you wish the session
    | to be allowed to remain idle before it expires. If you want them
    | to expire immediately when the browser is closed then you may
    | indicate that via the expire_on_close configuration option.
    |
    */

    'lifetime' => (int) env('SESSION_LIFETIME', 120),

    'expire_on_close' => env('SESSION_EXPIRE_ON_CLOSE', false),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Encryption
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option allows you to easily specify that all of your session data
    | should be encrypted before it's stored. All encryption is performed
    | automatically by Laravel and you may use the session like normal.
    |
    */

    'encrypt' => env('SESSION_ENCRYPT', false),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session File Location
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When utilizing the "file" session driver, the session files are placed
    | on disk. The default storage location is defined here; however, you
    | are free to provide another location where they should be stored.
    |
    */

    'files' => storage_path('framework/sessions'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Database Connection
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using the "database" or "redis" session drivers, you may specify a
    | connection that should be used to manage these sessions. This should
    | correspond to a connection in your database configuration options.
    |
    */

    'connection' => env('SESSION_CONNECTION'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Database Table
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using the "database" session driver, you may specify the table to
    | be used to store sessions. Of course, a sensible default is defined
    | for you; however, you're welcome to change this to another table.
    |
    */

    'table' => env('SESSION_TABLE', 'sessions'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cache Store
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using one of the framework's cache driven session backends, you may
    | define the cache store which should be used to store the session data
    | between requests. This must match one of your defined cache stores.
    |
    | Affects: "dynamodb", "memcached", "redis"
    |
    */

    'store' => env('SESSION_STORE'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Sweeping Lottery
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Some session drivers must manually sweep their storage location to get
    | rid of old sessions from storage. Here are the chances that it will
    | happen on a given request. By default, the odds are 2 out of 100.
    |
    */

    'lottery' => [2, 100],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cookie Name
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may change the name of the session cookie that is created by
    | the framework. Typically, you should not need to change this value
    | since doing so does not grant a meaningful security improvement.
    |
    */

    'cookie' => env(
        'SESSION_COOKIE',
        Str::slug((string) env('APP_NAME', 'laravel')).'-session'
    ),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cookie Path
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | The session cookie path determines the path for which the cookie will
    | be regarded as available. Typically, this will be the root path of
    | your application, but you're free to change this when necessary.
    |
    */

    'path' => env('SESSION_PATH', '/'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cookie Domain
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This value determines the domain and subdomains the session cookie is
    | available to. By default, the cookie will be available to the root
    | domain without subdomains. Typically, this shouldn't be changed.
    |
    */

    'domain' => env('SESSION_DOMAIN'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | HTTPS Only Cookies
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | By setting this option to true, session cookies will only be sent back
    | to the server if the browser has a HTTPS connection. This will keep
    | the cookie from being sent to you when it can't be done securely.
    |
    */

    'secure' => env('SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | HTTP Access Only
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Setting this value to true will prevent JavaScript from accessing the
    | value of the cookie and the cookie will only be accessible through
    | the HTTP protocol. It's unlikely you should disable this option.
    |
    */

    'http_only' => env('SESSION_HTTP_ONLY', true),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Same-Site Cookies
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option determines how your cookies behave when cross-site requests
    | take place, and can be used to mitigate CSRF attacks. By default, we
    | will set this value to "lax" to permit secure cross-site requests.
    |
    | See: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Set-Cookie#samesitesamesite-value
    |
    | Supported: "lax", "strict", "none", null
    |
    */

    'same_site' => env('SESSION_SAME_SITE', 'lax'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Partitioned Cookies
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Setting this value to true will tie the cookie to the top-level site for
    | a cross-site context. Partitioned cookies are accepted by the browser
    | when flagged "secure" and the Same-Site attribute is set to "none".
    |
    */

    'partitioned' => env('SESSION_PARTITIONED_COOKIE', false),

];

==================== backend\database\factories\UserFactory.php ====================
<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<User>
 */
class UserFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * The current password being used by the factory.
     */
    protected static ?string $password;

    /**
     * Define the model's default state.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => fake()->name(),
            'email' => fake()->unique()->safeEmail(),
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'password' => static::$password ??= Hash::make('password'),
            'remember_token' => Str::random(10),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Indicate that the model's email address should be unverified.
     */
    public function unverified(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'email_verified_at' => null,
        ]);
    }
}

==================== backend\public\.htaccess ====================
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    <IfModule mod_negotiation.c>
        Options -MultiViews -Indexes
    </IfModule>

    RewriteEngine On

    # Handle Authorization Header
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Authorization} .
    RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]

    # Handle X-XSRF-Token Header
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:x-xsrf-token} .
    RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_X_XSRF_TOKEN:%{HTTP:X-XSRF-Token}]

    # Redirect Trailing Slashes If Not A Folder...
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} (.+)/$
    RewriteRule ^ %1 [L,R=301]

    # Send Requests To Front Controller...
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
    RewriteRule ^ index.php [L]
</IfModule>

==================== backend\routes\api.php ====================
<?php

use App\Http\Controllers\Api\AuthController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Api\MenuItemController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Api\OrderController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Api\ReservationController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Api\TipReportController;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

/*
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
| Winning Spot Kitchen â€” API v1
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
|
| Public:
|   GET    /api/v1/menu
|   GET    /api/v1/menu/{menuItem}
|   POST   /api/v1/orders
|   POST   /api/v1/reservations
|   POST   /api/v1/login
|
| Staff (bearer token):
|   POST   /api/v1/admin/logout
|   GET    /api/v1/admin/orders
|   PATCH  /api/v1/admin/orders/{order}/status
|   GET    /api/v1/admin/reservations
|   PATCH  /api/v1/admin/reservations/{reservation}/status
|   GET    /api/v1/admin/tips/report
|   (plus menu-items CRUD for manager/supervisor)
*/

Route::prefix('v1')->group(function () {
    // -------- Public menu --------
    Route::get('menu', [MenuItemController::class, 'index']);
    Route::get('menu/{menuItem}', [MenuItemController::class, 'show']);

    // -------- Public orders & reservations --------
    Route::post('orders', [OrderController::class, 'store'])->middleware('throttle:10,1');
    Route::post('reservations', [ReservationController::class, 'store'])->middleware('throttle:5,1');

    // -------- Staff auth --------
    Route::post('login', [AuthController::class, 'login']);

    // -------- Authenticated staff area --------
    Route::middleware('auth:sanctum')->prefix('admin')->group(function () {
        Route::post('logout', [AuthController::class, 'logout']);

        // Manager + Supervisor
        Route::middleware('role:manager,supervisor')->group(function () {
            Route::apiResource('menu-items', MenuItemController::class)->except(['index', 'show']);
            Route::get('reservations', [ReservationController::class, 'index']);
            Route::patch('reservations/{reservation}/status', [ReservationController::class, 'updateStatus']);
        });

        // Manager + Supervisor + Staff
        Route::middleware('role:manager,supervisor,staff')->group(function () {
            Route::get('orders', [OrderController::class, 'index']);
            Route::patch('orders/{order}/status', [OrderController::class, 'updateStatus']);
        });

        // Manager only
        Route::middleware('role:manager')->group(function () {
            Route::get('tips/report', [TipReportController::class, 'index']);
        });
    });
});

==================== frontend\README.md ====================
# React + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend using TypeScript with type-aware lint rules enabled. Check out the [TS template](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/main/packages/create-vite/template-react-ts) for information on how to integrate TypeScript and [`typescript-eslint`](https://typescript-eslint.io) in your project.

import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

// https://vite.dev/config/
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
})

==================== frontend\src\api.js ====================
// All requests to the Laravel API. Public functions (menu, orders, reservations)
// need no auth. Admin functions send the signed-in user's Sanctum token via
// authHeaders() from auth.js, and hit routes under /admin which your
// routes/api.php protects with auth:sanctum + the role middleware.

import { authHeaders } from './auth';

const API = (import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000/api') + '/v1';

async function handle(res) {
  if (!res.ok) {
    let message = `Request failed (${res.status})`;
    try {
      const body = await res.json();
      message = body.message || (body.errors && Object.values(body.errors)[0]?.[0]) || message;
    } catch { /* response wasn't JSON */ }
    throw new Error(message);
  }
  if (res.status === 204) return null;
  return res.json();
}

/* ---------- PUBLIC ---------- */

export async function fetchMenu() {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/menu`, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
  return handle(res);
}

export async function createOrder(payload) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/orders`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
  return handle(res);
}

export async function createReservation(payload) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/reservations`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
  return handle(res);
}

/* ---------- ADMIN (requires a signed-in session) ---------- */

export async function fetchAdminOrders(page = 1) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/admin/orders?page=${page}`, {
    headers: { ...authHeaders(), Accept: 'application/json' },
  });
  return handle(res);
}

export async function updateOrderStatus(orderId, status) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/admin/orders/${orderId}/status`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: { ...authHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
  });
  return handle(res);
}

export async function fetchAdminReservations(page = 1) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/admin/reservations?page=${page}`, {
    headers: { ...authHeaders(), Accept: 'application/json' },
  });
  return handle(res);
}

export async function updateReservationStatus(reservationId, status) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/admin/reservations/${reservationId}/status`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: { ...authHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
  });
  return handle(res);
}

export async function createMenuItem(payload) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/admin/menu-items`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { ...authHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
  return handle(res);
}

export async function updateMenuItem(id, payload) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/admin/menu-items/${id}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    headers: { ...authHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
  return handle(res);
}

export async function deleteMenuItem(id) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/admin/menu-items/${id}`, {
    method: 'DELETE',
    headers: { ...authHeaders(), Accept: 'application/json' },
  });
  return handle(res);
}

export async function fetchTipsReport() {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/admin/tips/report`, {
    headers: { ...authHeaders(), Accept: 'application/json' },
  });
  return handle(res);
}

const SOCIALS = [
  ['Instagram', 'https://instagram.com', 'instagram'],
  ['Facebook', 'https://facebook.com', 'facebook'],
  ['X', 'https://x.com', 'x'],
  ['TikTok', 'https://tiktok.com', 'tiktok'],
  ['WhatsApp', 'https://wa.me/7046302002', 'whatsapp'],
];

function Socials() {
  return (
    <div className="socials">
      {SOCIALS.map(([name, href, key]) => (
        <a key={name} href={href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label={name} title={name}>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d={ICONS[key]} />
          </svg>
        </a>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

const fallback = (cat) => (e) => {
  if (e.currentTarget.dataset.fb) return;
  e.currentTarget.dataset.fb = '1';
  e.currentTarget.src = metaFor(cat).image;
};

/* ---------- DISH CARD with new two-button layout ---------- */
function Card({ item, add, addAndGo, detail }) {
  const low = item.available_quantity < 10;
  return (
    <article className="card">
      <div className="pic">
        <img src={item.image_url || metaFor(item.category).image} alt={item.name} loading="lazy" onError={fallback(item.category)} />
        <em className={low ? 'low' : ''}>{low ? `Only ${item.available_quantity} left` : 'Made fresh today'}</em>
        {item.ready && <span className="readytag">Ready now</span>}
      </div>
      <div className="cardbody">
        <small>{item.kind || item.category}</small>
        <h3>{item.name}</h3>
        {item.blurb && <p className="blurb">{item.blurb}</p>}
        {detail && <p className="stockline">{item.available_quantity} portions available</p>}
        <div className="cardfoot">
          <b>{money(item.price)}</b>
          <div className="cardbtns">
            <button
              className="btnadd"
              onClick={() => add(item)}
              aria-label={`Add ${item.name} to your bag`}
            >
              Add to bag
            </button>
            <button
              className="btnbuy"
              onClick={() => addAndGo(item)}
              aria-label={`Order ${item.name} now`}
            >
              Order now â†’
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

/* ---------- RESERVATION MODAL ---------- */
function Booking({ close }) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', email: '', phone: '', guest_count: '2', date: '', time: '19:00', occasion: '' });
  const set = (f) => (e) => setForm((s) => ({ ...s, [f]: e.target.value }));

  const submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    if (!form.date) { setError('Please choose a date.'); return; }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await createReservation({
        name: form.name, email: form.email, phone: form.phone,
        guest_count: Number(form.guest_count),
        reserved_at: `${form.date} ${form.time}:00`,
        occasion: form.occasion || null,
      });
      setDone(true);
    } catch (err) { setError(err.message); } finally { setSubmitting(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="overlay" onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && close()}>
      <div className="modal">
        <button className="x" onClick={close} aria-label="Close">Ã—</button>
        {done ? (
          <div className="done">
            <b>âœ¦</b>
            <small className="eyebrow">YOUR TABLE IS HELD</small>
            <h2>See you soon.</h2>
            <p>We've written your name in the book. A confirmation is on its way to your phone.</p>
            <button className="primary" onClick={close}>Wonderful</button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <small className="eyebrow">RESERVATIONS</small>
            <h2>Book a table</h2>
            <p>Tables are held for fifteen minutes past the booking time.</p>
            <form onSubmit={submit}>
              <label>Your name<input required placeholder="e.g. Ada Okafor" value={form.name} onChange={set('name')} /></label>
              <section>
                <label>Email<input required type="email" placeholder="you@email.com" value={form.email} onChange={set('email')} /></label>
                <label>Phone<input required placeholder="080..." value={form.phone} onChange={set('phone')} /></label>
              </section>
              <section>
                <label>Guests
                  <select value={form.guest_count} onChange={set('guest_count')}>
                    <option value="2">2 guests</option><option value="3">3 guests</option>
                    <option value="4">4 guests</option><option value="6">5â€“6 guests</option>
                    <option value="10">7+ (private room)</option>
                  </select>
                </label>
                <label>Date<input required type="date" value={form.date} onChange={set('date')} /></label>
              </section>
              <label>Time
                <select value={form.time} onChange={set('time')}>
                  {['13:00', '14:00', '18:00', '19:00', '20:00', '21:00'].map((t) => <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}
                </select>
              </label>
              <label>Occasion (optional)<input placeholder="Birthday, owambe, business lunchâ€¦" value={form.occasion} onChange={set('occasion')} /></label>
              {error && <p className="formerror">{error}</p>}
              <button className="primary full" disabled={submitting}>{submitting ? 'Reservingâ€¦' : 'Reserve table â†’'}</button>
            </form>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const ROLE_PICKS = [
  ['manager', 'Manager', 'Full access'],
  ['supervisor', 'Supervisor', 'Floor & kitchen'],
  ['staff', 'Staff', 'Orders only'],
];

/* ---------- ADMIN LOGIN ---------- */
function AdminLogin({ onSuccess, goHome }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ email: '', password: '' });
  const [role, setRole] = useState('manager');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const set = (f) => (e) => setForm((s) => ({ ...s, [f]: e.target.value }));

  const submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    if (!form.email || !form.password) { setError('Enter your work email and password.'); return; }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const session = await login(form.email, form.password);
      if (session.user.role !== role) {
        await logout();
        setError(`This account is registered as ${session.user.role}, not ${role}. Pick the matching role and try again.`);
        return;
      }
      onSuccess(session);
    } catch (err) { setError(err.message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  return (
    <section className="loginpage">
      <div className="logincard">
        <div className="loginmark"><i>W</i></div>
        <small className="eyebrow">STAFF ACCESS ONLY</small>
        <h1>Management sign in</h1>
        <p>This area is restricted to Winning Spot Kitchen staff. What you can see depends on your role.</p>

        <div className="rolepicks">
          {ROLE_PICKS.map(([value, label, sub]) => (
            <button
              key={value}
              type="button"
              className={role === value ? 'on' : ''}
              onClick={() => setRole(value)}
              aria-pressed={role === value}
            >
              <b>{label}</b><small>{sub}</small>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={submit}>
          <label>Work email<input type="email" autoComplete="username" placeholder="you@winningspot.ng" value={form.email} onChange={set('email')} /></label>
          <label>
            Password
            <div className="pwfield">
              <input
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢"
                value={form.password}
                onChange={set('password')}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="pwtoggle"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword((v) => !v)}
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                aria-pressed={showPassword}
                title={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? 'ðŸ™ˆ' : 'ðŸ‘'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </label>
          {error && <p className="formerror">{error}</p>}
          <button className="primary full" disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Signing inâ€¦' : `Sign in as ${ROLE_PICKS.find((r) => r[0] === role)[1]} â†’`}</button>
        </form>
        <button className="link" onClick={goHome}>â† Back to the restaurant</button>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

const money2 = (n) => `â‚¦${Number(n || 0).toLocaleString()}`;
const initialsOf = (name) => (name || '??').split(' ').map((w) => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);
const timeOf = (iso) => { try { return new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }); } catch { return ''; } };

/* ---------- ADMIN DASHBOARD (unchanged) ---------- */
function Admin({ menu, session, signOut }) {
  const user = session.user;
  const allowed = PERMISSIONS[user.role] || [];
  const [tab, setTab] = useState(allowed[0] || 'Overview');
  const links = ['Overview', 'Orders', 'Menu & stock', 'Reservations', 'Customers', 'Reports'];
  const permitted = can(user, tab);
  const initials = initialsOf(user.name);

  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [reservations, setReservations] = useState([]);
  const [tips, setTips] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [liveError, setLiveError] = useState('');
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const load = async () => {
      try {
        const jobs = [];
        if (can(user, 'Orders')) jobs.push(fetchAdminOrders().then((d) => !cancelled && setOrders(d.data || d)));
        if (can(user, 'Reservations')) jobs.push(fetchAdminReservations().then((d) => !cancelled && setReservations(d.data || d)));
        if (can(user, 'Reports')) jobs.push(fetchTipsReport().then((d) => !cancelled && setTips(d)));
        await Promise.all(jobs);
        if (!cancelled) setLiveError('');
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) setLiveError(err.message);
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    load();
    const id = setInterval(load, 8000);
    return () => { cancelled = true; clearInterval(id); };
  }, [session, user]);

  const changeOrderStatus = async (order, status) => {
    setBusyId(order.id);
    try {
      const updated = await updateOrderStatus(order.id, status);
      setOrders((list) => list.map((o) => (o.id === order.id ? { ...o, ...updated } : o)));
    } catch (err) { setLiveError(err.message); } finally { setBusyId(null); }
  };

  const changeReservationStatus = async (res, status) => {
    setBusyId(res.id);
    try {
      const updated = await updateReservationStatus(res.id, status);
      setReservations((list) => list.map((r) => (r.id === res.id ? { ...r, ...updated } : r)));
    } catch (err) { setLiveError(err.message); } finally { setBusyId(null); }
  };

  const revenueToday = orders.reduce((s, o) => s + Number(o.total || 0), 0);
  const tipsToday = orders.reduce((s, o) => s + Number(o.tip_amount || 0), 0);
  const activeOrders = orders.filter((o) => !['completed', 'cancelled'].includes(o.status));
  const pendingReservations = reservations.filter((r) => ['new', 'pending'].includes(r.status)).length;
  const weekTips = tips[0]?.total_tips ?? tipsToday;

  const customers = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map();
    for (const o of orders) {
      const key = o.customer_email || o.customer_name;
      if (!key) continue;
      const row = map.get(key) || { name: o.customer_name, email: o.customer_email, phone: o.customer_phone, orders: 0, spent: 0 };
      row.orders += 1;
      row.spent += Number(o.total || 0);
      map.set(key, row);
    }
    return [...map.values()].sort((a, b) => b.spent - a.spent);
  }, [orders]);

  return (
    <section className="admin">
      <aside>
        <div className="adminbrand"><i>W</i><b>Winning Spot</b><small>MANAGEMENT</small></div>
        {links.map((x) => {
          const ok = can(user, x);
          return (
            <button className={`${tab === x ? 'on' : ''}${ok ? '' : ' locked'}`} onClick={() => ok && setTab(x)} key={x} title={ok ? '' : 'Your role cannot open this'}>
              {x}{x === 'Orders' && ok && activeOrders.length > 0 && <em>{activeOrders.length}</em>}{!ok && <span className="lock">ðŸ”’</span>}
            </button>
          );
        })}
        <div className="manager">
          <i>{initials}</i>
          <span><b>{user.name}</b><small>{user.title || user.role}</small></span>
        </div>
        <button className="signout" onClick={signOut}>Sign out</button>
      </aside>
      <main>
        <header>
          <div>
            <small className="eyebrow">SIGNED IN AS {user.role.toUpperCase()}</small>
            <h1>{tab === 'Overview' ? `Good afternoon, ${user.name.split(' ')[0]}.` : tab}</h1>
          </div>
          {can(user, 'Orders') && <button className="primary">+ New order</button>}
        </header>

        {liveError && (<p className="formerror">Couldn't reach the API ({liveError}) â€” showing the last data loaded.</p>)}

        {!permitted ? (
          <div className="emptyadmin denied">
            <b>ðŸ”’</b>
            <h2>Not authorised</h2>
            <p>Your role ({user.role}) does not have access to {tab}. Ask a manager if you need it.</p>
          </div>
        ) : loading ? (
          <p className="loading">Loading live dataâ€¦</p>
        ) : tab === 'Orders' ? (
          <section className="panel fulllist">
            <h2>All orders</h2>
            <p>{orders.length} loaded Â· {activeOrders.length} active</p>
            {orders.map((o) => (
              <article className="order wide" key={o.id}>
                <i>{initialsOf(o.customer_name)}</i>
                <span>
                  <b>{o.customer_name}</b>
                  <small>{(o.items || []).map((it) => `${it.name} Ã— ${it.quantity}`).join(', ') || o.reference}</small>
                </span>
                <span><b>{o.type}</b><small>{o.customer_phone}</small></span>
                <span><b>{money2(o.total)}</b><small>{timeOf(o.created_at)}</small></span>
                <select className={`statuspick ${o.status}`} value={o.status} disabled={busyId === o.id} onChange={(e) => changeOrderStatus(o, e.target.value)}>
                  {['new', 'confirmed', 'preparing', 'ready', 'completed', 'cancelled'].map((s) => (<option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>))}
                </select>
              </article>
            ))}
            {!orders.length && <p className="loading">No orders yet.</p>}
          </section>
        ) : tab === 'Reservations' ? (
          <section className="panel fulllist">
            <h2>All reservations</h2>
            <p>{reservations.length} loaded Â· {pendingReservations} awaiting confirmation</p>
            {reservations.map((r) => (
              <article className="order wide" key={r.id}>
                <i>{initialsOf(r.name)}</i>
                <span><b>{r.name}</b><small>{r.email} Â· {r.phone}</small></span>
                <span><b>{r.guest_count} guests</b><small>{r.occasion || 'No occasion given'}</small></span>
                <span><b>{r.reserved_at ? new Date(r.reserved_at).toLocaleDateString() : ''}</b><small>{timeOf(r.reserved_at)}</small></span>
                <select className={`statuspick ${r.status}`} value={r.status} disabled={busyId === r.id} onChange={(e) => changeReservationStatus(r, e.target.value)}>
                  {['new', 'confirmed', 'seated', 'completed', 'cancelled'].map((s) => (<option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>))}
                </select>
              </article>
            ))}
            {!reservations.length && <p className="loading">No reservations yet.</p>}
          </section>
        ) : tab === 'Menu & stock' ? (
          <section className="panel stock fulllist">
            <h2>Menu &amp; stock</h2>
            <p>{menu.length} items on the menu</p>
            {menu.map((x) => (
              <article key={x.id}>
                <i className="thumb"><img src={x.image_url} alt={x.name} onError={fallback(x.category)} /></i>
                <b>{x.name}</b>
                <span><em style={{ width: Math.min(100, x.available_quantity * 8) + '%' }} /></span>
                <small>{x.available_quantity} left</small>
              </article>
            ))}
          </section>
        ) : tab === 'Customers' ? (
          <section className="panel fulllist">
            <h2>Customers</h2>
            <p>{customers.length} customers from loaded orders</p>
            {customers.map((c) => (
              <article className="order wide" key={c.email || c.name}>
                <i>{initialsOf(c.name)}</i>

                <span><b>{c.phone}</b></span>
                <span><b>{c.orders} order{c.orders === 1 ? '' : 's'}</b><small>{money2(c.spent)} lifetime</small></span>
              </article>
            ))}
            {!customers.length && <p className="loading">No customer data yet.</p>}
          </section>
        ) : tab === 'Reports' ? (
          <section className="panel fulllist">

            {tips.map((row) => (
              <article className="order wide" key={row.week}>
                <span><b>Week {row.week}</b></span>
                <span><b>{money2(row.total_tips)}</b></span>
              </article>
            ))}
            {!tips.length && <p className="loading">No tip data yet.</p>}
          </section>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="stats">
              {[
                ['Revenue (loaded orders)', money2(revenueToday), `${orders.length} orders in view`],
                ['Active orders', activeOrders.length, `${orders.length} total loaded`],
                ['Tips (loaded orders)', money2(tipsToday), can(user, 'Reports') ? `${money2(weekTips)} this week` : 'Ask a manager for reports'],
                ['Pending reservations', pendingReservations, `${reservations.length} total loaded`],
              ].map((x) => (
                <div key={x[0]}><small>{x[0]}</small><h2>{x[1]}</h2><p>{x[2]}</p></div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="admincols">
              <section className="panel">

                  <article className="order" key={o.id}>
                    <i>{initialsOf(o.customer_name)}</i>
                    <span><b>{o.customer_name}</b><small>{(o.items || []).map((it) => `${it.name} Ã— ${it.quantity}`).join(', ') || o.reference}</small></span>
                    <span><b>{money2(o.total)}</b><small>{timeOf(o.created_at)}</small></span>
                    {can(user, 'Orders') ? (
                      <select className={`statuspick ${o.status}`} value={o.status} disabled={busyId === o.id} onChange={(e) => changeOrderStatus(o, e.target.value)}>
                        {['new', 'confirmed', 'preparing', 'ready', 'completed', 'cancelled'].map((s) => (<option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>))}
                      </select>
                    ) : (<em className={o.status}>{o.status}</em>)}
                  </article>
                ))}
                {!orders.length && <p className="loading">No orders loaded yet.</p>}

              <section className="panel">
                <h2>Reservations</h2>

                  <article className="order" key={r.id}>

    setCart((c) => {
      const hit = c.find((x) => x.id === item.id);
      return hit ? c.map((x) => (x.id === item.id ? { ...x, qty: x.qty + 1 } : x)) : [...c, { ...item, qty: 1 }];
    });
    setLastAdded(item);
    setMiniCartVisible(true);
    setNote({
      text: msg || `${item.name} added to your bag`,
      link: { label: 'View bag â†’', go: () => go('cart') },
    });
  };

      const hit = c.find((x) => x.id === item.id);
      return hit ? c.map((x) => (x.id === item.id ? { ...x, qty: x.qty + 1 } : x)) : [...c, { ...item, qty: 1 }];
    });
    setMiniCartVisible(false);

      setCart((c) => c.filter((x) => x.id !== id));

  const total = subtotal + service + tip;

/* ---------- Takeaway card with quantity stepper ---------- */
function TakeawayCard({ item, onAdd, onBuy }) {
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(1);
  return (
    <article>
      <div className="takepic">
        <img src={item.image_url} alt={item.name} loading="lazy" onError={fallback(item.category)} />
        <span>â— Ready</span>
      </div>
      <div className="takebody">
        <h3>{item.name}</h3>
        <small>{item.available_quantity} portions in the warmer</small>
        <div className="takefoot">
          <b>{money(item.price)}</b>
          <div className="takeqty">
            <button aria-label="Decrease" onClick={() => setQty((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1))}>âˆ’</button>
            <b>{qty}</b>
            <button aria-label="Increase" onClick={() => setQty((q) => Math.min(item.available_quantity, q + 1))}>+</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="takebtns">
          <button
            className="btnadd"
            onClick={() => { for (let i = 0; i < qty; i++) onAdd(item); setQty(1); }}
          >
            Add {qty} to bag
          </button>
          <button
            className="btnbuy"
            onClick={() => { for (let i = 0; i < qty; i++) onBuy(item); }}
          >
            Buy now â†’
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

==================== frontend\src\auth.js ====================
// Admin authentication + authorisation helper.
// Talks to the Laravel API (Sanctum token auth) under the /v1 prefix your
// routes/api.php uses.

const API = (import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000/api') + '/v1';
const KEY = 'wsk-session';

// Role â†’ which admin tabs that role may open. Mirrors the role:... middleware
// groups in routes/api.php â€” this is a convenience for the UI only; the
// server is what actually enforces it.
export const PERMISSIONS = {
  manager: ['Overview', 'Orders', 'Menu & stock', 'Reservations', 'Customers', 'Reports'],
  supervisor: ['Overview', 'Orders', 'Menu & stock', 'Reservations'],
  staff: ['Overview', 'Orders'],
};

export const can = (user, tab) =>
  !!user && (PERMISSIONS[user.role] || []).includes(tab);

export function loadSession() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function saveSession(session) {
  try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(session)); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  return session;
}

export async function login(email, password) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/login`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password, device_name: 'admin-panel' }),
  });

  if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 422) {
    throw new Error('Those details do not match our records.');
  }
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error('Could not reach the server. Please try again.');
  }

  const data = await res.json();
  if (!data?.user?.role) throw new Error('This account has no admin role assigned.');

  return saveSession({ token: data.token, user: data.user });
}

export async function logout() {
  const session = loadSession();
  try {
    if (session) {
      await fetch(`${API}/admin/logout`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${session.token}`, Accept: 'application/json' },
      });
    }
  } catch { /* ignore â€” we clear the local session either way */ }
  try { localStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

// Use for any authenticated admin request.
export function authHeaders() {
  const s = loadSession();
  return s ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${s.token}` } : {};
}
